facts.fact: The South African Revenue Service says it has deployed Ask Lwazi, an AI assistant on its website that lets taxpayers ask questions.
Sars says machine-learning models in its compliance operations rank cases by collection probability and flag taxpayers to register or under-declaring income, passing risk signals to case selection.
Sars commissioner Johnstone Makhubu says its algorithms have stopped more than R100-million of impermissible funds from going out.
